fusions.name: Bitter Sip
fusions.desc: A bite on a target carrying one of your afflictions: it uses that affliction up, deals 8 poison damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pass the Dose
fusions.desc: A beat of your wings deals 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and restores 6 health to you. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Purge and Flit
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Carrier's Blood
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them, and you have 12% poison resistance.
